English.Text: Moot Points — The Speech
The council have finally welcomed me among the elders of the Keftanya Moot! Help me prepare my acceptance speech!
Thank you... for helping me understand what I needed to do in my speech.
I'm not saying that, you wicked bushpig!
The Elder has been invited to join a council of Elders and wants your help preparing a speech.

Elder Tebibi: 'I have several ideas on how to open my speech, but I'm uncertain which would be most efficacious. First I am to stand and call "Dear Council members", then...Hm, what is most important in my first impression?'

Elder Tebibi needs your help fine-tuning her acceptance speech for the Keftanya Moot. She has been waiting ever since her husband died to join this committee and does not wish to ruin her chances of success at what she considers the final hurdle.
Elder Tebibi: 'Good, I shall consider that...Now, a series of necessary flourishes and acknowledgements, then on to the matter at hand: "There is much to be done. Our first mandate should be..."'
Elder Tebibi: 'There will be much murmuring and discussion at that point I like to think— but I will control it easily. Now to the conclusion: "By the grace of the Lord I solemnly swear that...'
'Your vote of confidence—for once in my life— humbles me...'
'I rejoice in joining forces with you for, clearly, the greater good of our city...'
'Long...very long...have I awaited this honour!'
'The needs of the lowliest, as befits the virtuous...'
'To strive to encourage piety and abidance with the covenant...'
'To lessen the burdens of the Elders, that we may better uplift Enbesa...'
'I will make my tenure with the Moot my life's work!'
'I will not rest until this Moot's influence reaches beyond Taborime, to the whole of Enbesa!'
'Order will be restored, and the righteous uplifted...'
The Elder thanks you for the small part you played in composing the final speech.
The Elder offers not even the faintest smile at your suggestion.
Help the Elder compose her speech for the Moot
